fact: The party encounters the Bone Pyramid Islet on the fifteenth day of their voyage.
source_quote: On the fifteenth day of their voyage, the tunnel forked around a diamond-shaped limestone islet
subject: fifteenth day of their voyage

fact: Blind cavefish drift mindlessly near the surface of the subterranean waterway.
source_quote: Blind cavefish drifted mindlessly near the surface
subject: blind cavefish

fact: The blind cavefish occasionally bump against the hull of the boat.
source_quote: occasionally bumping against the hull of the boat
subject: blind cavefish

fact: The limestone islet is diamond-shaped and forty feet wide.
source_quote: a diamond-shaped limestone islet, forty feet wide
subject: limestone islet

fact: The limestone islet features jagged stalagmites jutting upward from the water.
source_quote: its jagged stalagmites jutting upward from the water like broken teeth
subject: limestone islet

fact: There is a pyramid of bones at the center of the islet.
source_quote: It was a pyramid of bones
subject: pyramid of bones

fact: The pyramid of bones is eight feet high.
source_quote: eight feet high
subject: pyramid of bones

fact: The pyramid of bones is five feet wide at its base.
source_quote: five feet wide at its base
subject: pyramid of bones

fact: The pyramid of bones is crowned with a great horned ram skull.
source_quote: crowned with a great horned ram skull
subject: horned ram skull

fact: The horned ram skull is positioned so its empty sockets stare directly at the travelers.
source_quote: so its empty sockets stared directly at them
subject: horned ram skull

fact: Brannum Redmarch panics upon seeing the bone pyramid.
source_quote: Brannum Redmarch took one look at it and panicked
subject: Brannum Redmarch

fact: Brannum Redmarch shouts for the party to dock.
source_quote: shouting "shit, dock! Do something!"
subject: Brannum Redmarch

fact: Brannum Redmarch admits that the current direction was a mistake.
source_quote: admitting "this was a mistake
subject: Brannum Redmarch

fact: Brannum Redmarch states he thought they were going the other way.
source_quote: I thought we were going the other way
subject: Brannum Redmarch

fact: A violent beam of lightning erupts from behind a stalactite above the islet.
source_quote: a violent beam of lightning erupted from behind a stalactite above the islet
subject: lightning strike

fact: The lightning tries to pierce the hull of the boat.
source_quote: and tried to put a hole in their boat
subject: lightning strike

fact: The party makes a group check to keep the vessel from taking on water.
source_quote: The party made a group check to keep the vessel from taking on water
subject: group check to keep vessel seaworthy

fact: The boat sustains damage but remains seaworthy due to quick reflexes.
source_quote: their quick reflexes kept the boat seaworthy with only some damage
subject: boat damage

fact: A ten-foot floating sphere of rotting flesh and dead eyes rises from behind the great stalactite.
source_quote: rising from behind the great stalactite, a ten-foot floating sphere of rotting flesh and dead eyes
subject: beholder zombie

fact: The creature is identified as a beholder zombie.
source_quote: a beholder zombie
subject: beholder zombie

fact: The beholder zombie was drawn by the commotion.
source_quote: drawn by the commotion
subject: beholder zombie

fact: The beholder zombie is hungry for destruction.
source_quote: hungry for destruction
subject: beholder zombie

fact: Gyrgum casts the spell Command.
source_quote: Gyrgum cast Command
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum orders the beholder zombie to flee.
source_quote: ordered the creature to flee
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum realizes the undead horror does not understand his commands.
source_quote: realize with a sinking feeling that the undead horror understood nothing he said
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The battle between the party and the beholder zombie begins.
source_quote: The battle was joined in earnest
subject: battle joined

fact: The party takes a long rest along the way before reaching the islet.
source_quote: The party takes a long rest along the way
subject: long rest

fact: The tunnel is illuminated by a purple glow.
source_quote: narrow, eerie tunnel illuminated by a purple glow
subject: narrow, eerie tunnel

fact: Thorin starts rowing away from the islet.
source_quote: Thorin starts rowing away
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin trusts that Brannum Redmarch knows what he is talking about.
source_quote: trusting that Brannum knows what he is talking about
subject: Thorin
